entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Don't be ridiculous!

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: This new ally you gained was Makoto!?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Just tell me the truth!
You already know the truth.
You're clueless, huh?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Makoto...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Suddenly gone quiet, huh?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: That's preposterous. If what you say[n]is true...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...Was Makoto also running from the[n]police when you were arrested!?
I don't want to say.
Ask her yourself.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Now that I think about it... she did start[n]talking a lot about the investigation[n]from summer onward...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Makoto aside, you mentioned one other[n]important detail.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Did Kaneshiro really say there was[n]someone using the Metaverse besides[n]the Phantom Thieves?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Those words could just be taken as you[n]shifting blame to this other person,[n]you know.
It's the truth.
Take it how you will.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: But why would you fabricate such an[n]elaborate story and then shift the blame[n]elsewhere?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: There are two possibilities: either you've[n]simply been trying to confuse me with[n]your lies...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...Or everything you've stated is true.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Have you been telling me the truth from[n]the very start?
Of course.
I have no reason to lie.
You can decide that.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Does that mean you're placing[n]your trust in me?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: That's the plan.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...Then again, I am investigating a[n]"thief who steals hearts."

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Very well. No matter how absurd it may[n]seem, I'll reevaluate my stance on[n]believing you for now.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: In return, speak the whole truth, and[n]nothing but the truth.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: It's a fair deal... Is that acceptable?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: We're running out of time. Let's move on[n]to your next target...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Actually, I should rephrase that: they[n]targeted your group first, didn't they?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: The identity of your opponent... is this.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: We have no pictures. Even their names[n]and identities are unknown.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: If what you told me is true, then this[n]"Nav" thing you've mentioned wouldn't[n]have worked in this case.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: How did you target them?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Tell me everything.
I've made a deal with Sae Niijima...
